name: list_projects
summary: List the projects in this studio: id, name and how many patterns each has. Start here when you do not know a project id.

name: create_project
summary: Create a project. `starter: social` gives it five ready patterns (Story, Post, Square, Landscape, Banner) with a headline slot each; `blank` gives one empty pattern.

name: get_project
summary: A project's patterns, how much Yarn it has, and its brand (colours, fonts and voice).

name: set_project_picture
summary: Show one of a project's images or videos (from its Yarn) on the project's card in the studio, so the person knows it at a glance. A logo or a key photo works well. Leave out yarnId to take the picture away.

params.name: yarnId
params.description: An image's yarn id, from list_yarn

name: list_yarn
summary: List the files (Yarn) in a project: images, video, audio, fonts and saved copy. Filter by kind, tag, a search word or a folder. Use a Yarn name or id when filling an image slot.

params.name: kind
params.description: One of image, video, audio, font, copy.

params.name: folder
params.description: Only Yarn in this folder and the folders inside it, like Royalty free music

name: import_yarn
summary: Add a file to a project's Yarn from a public web address: an image, a video, a sound, a font (to use it in a swatch) or a text file. Or save a piece of text as reusable copy. Local files are not accepted here; ask the person to upload them in the studio. A file that is already there is not added twice: you get the one there, with these tags added.

params.name: url
params.description: A public https link to a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, SVG, MP4, MOV, WebM, MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 or a text file file

params.name: text
params.description: Copy to save, instead of a file

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to give it, like ["product"], so a slot can take `tag:product`

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder it goes in, as a path from the top of its section, like Royalty free music/Lo-fi. Made when it is not there. Left out, the top.

name: tag_yarn
summary: Set the tags on a piece of Yarn. Tags let a batch pick from a group, like `tag:product`.

name: rename
summary: Rename a pattern, a piece of Yarn or a folder: give its patternId, its yarnId, or a folder's path with the projectId and section it is in, and the new name. A folder's new name may be a whole path, to move it and everything in it: Music/Lo-fi puts it inside Music, /Lo-fi at the top; into a folder that is there already, the two become one. Use it to label a draft of your own, like "Draft: spring post"; only a person deletes, in the studio.

params.name: folder
params.description: A folder's path, from list_folders, like Royalty free music/Lofi

params.name: section
params.description: Which section the folder is in: each of patterns, yarn, parts, swatches and knits has folders of its own. One of patterns, yarn, parts, swatches, knits.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The project the folder is in

name: get_brand_guidelines
summary: The brand's colours, fonts and how it writes (voice, do and do-not lists, examples). Read this before writing any copy.

name: propose_swatch
summary: Propose a brand (a swatch) for the person to review: read it from the brand's website (url), give it yourself (colors, fonts, voice), or both, and what you give wins over what the site says. It is saved as a NEW swatch and never made the project's: the person looks it over in the Swatch tab and presses Use for this project. Fonts are matched to the bundled ones and to font files in the project's Yarn, so import_yarn a brand's font file first to use it. A swatch needs a primary, a text and a background colour.

params.name: url
params.description: The brand's website, to read its colours, fonts, name and logo from

params.name: rules
params.description: How the brand draws its shapes: {"cornerRadius": 0.04}, a fraction of the frame's width from 0 (square) to 0.2. A stitch uses it with style radius: "$radius".

params.name: logoYarnId
params.description: An image already in this project's Yarn to use as its logo, instead of the site's

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder the swatch goes in, as a path from the top of its section, like Royalty free music/Lo-fi. Made when it is not there. Left out, the top.

name: list_patterns
summary: The patterns in a project.

name: get_pattern
summary: A pattern as data: every stitch, with slot names, locked or free, and coordinates as fractions of the frame. Large; prefer describe_pattern.

name: describe_pattern
summary: A short text summary of a pattern: what slots it has, which are locked by the brand and which you may fill, what it says now, any animation, and the brand's voice. The cheapest way to understand a pattern.

name: create_pattern
summary: Add an empty pattern to a project. Sizes: Story 1080x1920, Post 1080x1350, Square 1080x1080, Landscape 1920x1080, Banner 1456x816.

params.name: size
params.description: One of Story, Post, Square, Landscape, Banner.

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder the pattern goes in, as a path from the top of its section, like Royalty free music/Lo-fi. Made when it is not there. Left out, the top.

name: duplicate_pattern
summary: Copy a pattern, locks and all.

name: fill_slots
summary: Write into a pattern's named slots. A text slot takes text. An image or video slot takes a Yarn name or id from list_yarn, or `tag:product` for the first file with that tag. A slot inside a part is addressed `part.slot`, like `lower_third.name`. Locked slots are REFUSED and reported: if you are refused, tell the person, do not look for another way around it. Returns what was filled and what was refused with the reason.

params.name: slots
params.description: slot name to content, like {"headline": "Spring sale", "photo": "Hero shot"}

name: add_stitch
summary: Add a stitch. Coordinates are fractions of the frame (0 to 1). kind: text, image, shape. Give it a slot name so it can be filled later. Text sizes in style.fontSize are fractions of the frame WIDTH (0.05 is a modest body size, 0.1 a headline).

params.name: yarnId
params.description: A yarn id, for an image stitch

params.name: style
params.description: Use brand tokens like $color.primary and $font.display rather than hex values

name: update_stitch
summary: Change a stitch's text, position, size, image or style. Address it by slot name.

params.name: patch
params.description: Any of x, y, w, h, content, yarnId, style (merged over the existing style)

name: remove_stitch
summary: Remove a stitch. Locked stitches are refused.

name: set_size
summary: Change a pattern's size. Everything is stored as fractions, so it re-lays out. Check the result with preview_pattern.

params.name: size
params.description: One of Story, Post, Square, Landscape, Banner.

name: apply_batch
summary: Apply several edit commands as ONE step, so a person can undo it as one. `atomic: true` applies all or nothing. Each command is {type, ...}: addStitch {stitch}, updateStitch {id, patch}, removeStitch {id}, reorder {id, toIndex}, setSize {size}, fillSlot {slot, content} (text slots only; set an image with updateStitch and a yarnId), setMeta {name, durationMs}, setMotion {stitchId, clips}, setAudio {audio}. setLocked is refused: only a person locks or unlocks.

name: list_parts
summary: Reusable parts you can insert: lower thirds, quotes, price tags and the project's own. Each lists its slots.

name: insert_part
summary: Put a part into a pattern. Then fill its slots with fill_slots using `instance.slot`.

name: create_part
summary: Make a reusable part out of stitches already in a pattern, like a footer every pattern repeats, so insert_part can put it anywhere and a change to the part lands everywhere it is used. Each stitch with a slot name becomes a slot of the part; a slot the brand locked stays locked. `replace: true` also swaps those stitches in this pattern for one linked copy of the part. The part belongs to the pattern's project.

params.name: stitches
params.description: The slot names or ids of the stitches to make it from

params.name: name
params.description: What to call the part, like Footer

params.name: description
params.description: What it is for, in a sentence

params.name: category
params.description: One of text, media, motion, frame, cta, other.

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder the part goes in, as a path from the top of its section, like Royalty free music/Lo-fi. Made when it is not there. Left out, the top.

name: list_presets
summary: The animation presets available to set_motion.

name: set_motion
summary: Animate a stitch: give it clips, each {preset, startMs, endMs}. Replaces that stitch's clips. Also set the pattern's length with durationMs if the animation runs past it. Keep text on screen long enough to read (about 3 words a second).

name: list_voices
summary: The voices available for voiceover, and whether the configured voice works right now.

name: synthesize_voiceover
summary: Speak lines and put them on the pattern's timeline as sound, optionally with timed captions. Returns a job id: check it with get_job. The pattern becomes a video long enough for the speech.

name: preview_pattern
summary: Render the pattern and SEE it: returns a PNG. Use it after layout changes to check your own work. `time` is milliseconds for animated patterns.

name: check_pattern
summary: Run the same quality checks Knit runs, without drawing anything: missing files, low contrast, text that will not fit, animation that is too busy. Fix errors before knitting.

name: knit_pattern
summary: Make real files (PNG, JPEG, WebP or MP4) from a pattern, through the same job the studio's Knit button uses, with the same checks. `params`: sizes (array of {name,w,h}), format, scale (1 or 2), rows (an array of objects of slot values, one per post, to make many). A row may only fill free slots. Returns file paths and any issues, or a jobId when wait is false.

name: get_job
summary: Check on a job: a knit or a voiceover.

name: cancel_job
summary: Stop a running job.

name: list_knits
summary: What has been knitted in a project, newest first.

params.name: folder
params.description: Only knits in this folder and the folders inside it

name: list_folders
summary: How a project's things are sorted: each section (patterns, yarn, parts, swatches, knits) has folders of its own, which can hold folders. Each folder is a path like Royalty free music/Lo-fi, with how many things are in it, not counting the folders inside. Give a section for just that one.

params.name: section
params.description: Which section the folder is in: each of patterns, yarn, parts, swatches and knits has folders of its own. One of patterns, yarn, parts, swatches, knits.

name: move_to_folder
summary: File things into a folder, to sort a project the way its person thinks of it: one folder per campaign, a folder for royalty free music with one inside for each kind. Give the folder as a path, like Royalty free music/Lo-fi, or "" for the top; it is made when it is not there, in each section the things are from. Give the ids of what to move, of one kind or several. Moving changes nothing else about them. To move or rename a folder itself, use rename.

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder's path, like Royalty free music/Lo-fi, or "" for the top

params.name: yarnIds
params.description: The ids of the Yarn to move

params.name: patternIds
params.description: The ids of the patterns to move

params.name: partIds
params.description: The ids of the parts (not the starter parts) to move

params.name: swatchIds
params.description: The ids of the swatches to move

params.name: knitIds
params.description: The ids of the knits to move
